about: Since last 8+ years we are handling shipping of cars from Dubai to various destinations worldwide. We can also act as an sourcing agent for any vehicle or car parts enquiry. We work mainly with car traders and regular car importers. Shipping is possible via air – sea – land transport. Payment terms are cash in Dubai, bank transfer to our company account and letter of credit L/C.

We are one of the leading vehicle exporting companies in Dubai, UAE. Our core business is to source and export new vehicles from UAE to the rest of the world. We are specialised in the exporting of brand new cars, pickup, buses, vans, auto spare parts and car accessories.
